d.ko: Imopara 3 is a visual novel developed by MOONSTONE Cherry, a sub-brand of the renowned Japanese bishoujo game company MOONSTONE. With themes of youth, growth, and adventure, this heartwarming classic is now available on Steam with Simplified Chinese support.

d.zh: 《极乐妹土！3》是曾在萌系游戏大奖中两度获奖的「极乐妹土！」系列最新作，具有用户公认放心的高品质！通过暑假事件，与性格各异的妹妹们一同享受生活。每位角色拥有不同的兴趣爱好，玩家将化身哥哥陪伴妹妹成长。
